errors.text_span: което е почти двойно повече от следващия по височина стълб — 2005 г.
errors.evidence: The description states that the value for 2007 (approx. 10,000) is 'almost double' the value for 2005 (approx. 3,500). This is a significant miscalculation, as the value for 2007 is almost three times, not two times, the value for 2005. This constitutes a false interpretation of the visual data.
